dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses COPY includes with .INC extension, file paths like /usr/local/orca/, and shell/MCP interface patterns typical of ORCA
evidence: LINKAGE SECTION with USING SPA-AREA ORCHC30AREA

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software - medication information list printing component (薬情一覧印字, HC30)
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system and handles printing of medication information lists (薬情). It reads drug/medication master data and point-score master data, formats medication details including effects, cautions, images, and drug names into a tabular layout, and outputs print data for patient medication information sheets.

notable_features: 24 COPY statements for modular include files
LINKAGE SECTION with SPA-AREA and ORCHC30AREA parameters
File output via SELECT PRT-FILE ASSIGN HC01PARA
Japanese multi-byte character handling (EUC-JP encoded comments)
Reference modification (substring) operations on working storage
OCCURS clauses for multi-entry medication table layout
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary MCP DB interface
Image file path handling for drug photos
verdict.notes: Source comments are encoded in EUC-JP (displayed as latin-1 mojibake). This is a well-known open-source Japanese medical software system. The file is truncated at 16000 chars but the structure is clear. No COMP-3 usage; numeric fields use standard PIC 9 declarations consistent with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL target.
